info.title: SkySwap API
info.description: Sky objects from real NASA SPHEREx images, served from the SkySwap data kit. Send the header x-tz-offset (minutes east of UTC, for example -180 in Brasilia) so days for streaks and daily limits follow the local calendar.

SkySpot.description: A sky card that already exists, in the shape POST /api/classify/sky takes. Build it and register it like a fresh one.

anyOf.description: A sky card that already exists, in the shape POST /api/classify/sky takes. Build it and register it like a fresh one.
Estimate, not a verdict: the chance that it moves, computed from the answers so far.

incomplete.description: True when the archive could not be asked (offline) or did not answer for every collection: an empty or short list is then not proof that no image exists.

get.summary: All 102 SPHEREx colours at one sky point, read from the IRSA DR1 all-sky cube (a quick look, not a measurement)
